title: Size run and price by size
objective: Look up the size run and the unit price for each order line, using the size as the key.
instructions: For each order line, use XLOOKUP with the size wanted in column B as the key and the size table in F1:H10 as the source. In C2:C6 return the pairs in the size run (column G). In D2:D6 return the unit price (column H). Fix the table ranges with $ signs. If a size is not in the table, show the text "Not stocked" in both columns.
hints: XLOOKUP has three parts and one optional part: =XLOOKUP(what to find, where to look, what to return, [if not found]).
For C2, find B2 in the Size column F2:F10 and return the matching cell from the Pairs column G2:G10. For D2, use the same key but return from H2:H10.
Write the table ranges with $ signs ($F$2:$F$10, $G$2:$G$10, $H$2:$H$10) so they do not move when you copy the formula down. Only B2 should change from row to row.
Add "Not stocked" in double quotes as the fourth argument so a missing size shows that text instead of #N/A.
